title: Subscription App: Kahani+ Streaming
description: Kahani+ is a fictional Indian streaming and learning app with a 7-day free trial and Basic, Standard and Premium plans (monthly or annual, priced in INR). The data tracks 5,200 signups from 2023-2024 through trial, first payment, renewals and cancellation, along with a raw event log. Use it for funnel conversion, retention curves, cohort analysis, churn drivers and plan mix.

tables.name: users
tables.description: One row per signup (8 duplicate rows are deliberate).

columns.name: platform
columns.description: Android, iOS or Web at signup

tables.name: subscriptions
tables.description: One row per user who started a free trial; tracks conversion, renewal and end.

columns.name: price_inr
columns.description: Price per billing period in INR

columns.name: paid_start_date
columns.description: Date of first payment (NULL if never converted)

columns.name: end_date
columns.description: Trial expiry date (if not converted) or end of paid service (if cancelled); NULL while active/trialing

columns.name: cancel_date
columns.description: Date the user requested cancellation (NULL if not cancelled)

columns.name: renewal_count
columns.description: Number of successful renewals after the first payment

tables.name: events
tables.description: Raw product and billing event log (~0.5% exact duplicates).

columns.name: event_name
columns.description: signup, trial_start, trial_expired, payment_success, renewal_success, payment_failed, cancel_subscription, app_open, content_view, search (some UPPERCASE)

columns.name: plan
columns.description: Plan at the time of the event (NULL before a plan is chosen)

columns.name: platform
columns.description: Platform of the user (some lowercase values)

qualityIssues: events: ~0.5% (about 100) exact duplicate rows (same event_id); users: 8 exact duplicates. Neither table has a PRIMARY KEY constraint on its id.
events.event_name: ~1.2% of values are UPPERCASE ('APP_OPEN'); events.platform: ~2% are lowercase ('android') - breaks naive GROUP BY.
users.email ~6% NULL; users.city ~4% NULL and ~10% inconsistent casing/whitespace.

events.plan is NULL for events before a plan is chosen (signup and most early engagement events); subscriptions.paid_start_date NULL for users who never paid; cancel_date/end_date NULL by design for active users.
CSV only - users.signup_date ~15% and subscriptions.trial_start_date ~10%: DD-MM-YYYY; events.event_time ~10%: DD-MM-YYYY HH:MM:SS.
CSV only - subscriptions.price_inr: ~40% of rows are text such as '₹299'.

signals: [Instructor note] Funnel: signup -> trial_start (~63%) -> payment_success (~36% of trials) -> renewals; iOS converts trials noticeably better (~50%) than Android (~34%).
[Instructor note] The March 2024 signup cohort churns far faster (about 2.7x hazard) - month-1 and month-2 retention is visibly worse than neighbouring cohorts.
[Instructor note] Influencer-sourced users start trials often but convert at less than half the normal rate and churn faster; Referral users convert ~25% better.
[Instructor note] Basic plan churns more than Premium; annual plans have almost no churn in the first year but low renewal at month 12.
[Instructor note] Oct-Nov (Diwali) cohorts convert ~20% better; signups grow strongly through 2024.
[Instructor note] About 3.5% of renewal charges fail (payment_failed), and ~45% of those lead to involuntary cancellation.
[Instructor note] Engagement events (app_open, content_view) cluster in the first 14 days after signup and decay for churners.
